user_direction: Both RGB and DSM information; reuse already completed unimodal experiments
superseded_suggestion: Retraining fresh RGB-only and DSM-only anchors is withdrawn

dsm.normalization: native per-tile minmax DSM repeated3; no ImageNet normalization

selection: mean complete clean, RGB-only clean, DSM-only clean on Val2 at4000/8000, earliest ties; fixed8000 diagnostic retained
decision_source: 2026-10-02 user: 按上述实验规划进行具体实验

data.input: RGB plus existing per-tile normalized DSM
data.held4_policy: not loaded this round; historical Train16 checkpoint exposure means not an independent holdout
data.sampling: D23 aligned keyed fit crop stream; D26 independent keyed R-quality/D-quality/availability draws

training.selection: mean pooled NoBoundary fg5 across three states; ties earlier

runtime.queue: dynamic two physical GPUs; fixed jobs; job RNG independent of assignment
runtime.determinism: strict frozen arms; J0 warn_only for native DSM bilinear CUDA backward; no bitwise multiGPU promise

architecture.stride4: native RGB stride4 unchanged; DSM preclassifier stride1 reduced by fixed avgpool4 before128channel projection; nondivisible generic shapes nearest fallback; no adaptive/bilinear CUDA backward
architecture.interaction: four direction/scale blocks; pack2x2 width512 each; interleaved recipient/donor1024 -> grouped4 Conv3x3 256 so every group sees both; condition18 -> Conv1x1 256; GELU; grouped4 projection512 x sigmoid(grouped4 gate512); inverse basis; scale mean
architecture.semantic: detached both6class distributions and abs difference; noS first6 projected private channels and abs difference
architecture.capacity: CAP same four blocks, self-only donor and condition channels0:18; all block parameters participate
architecture.shuffle: fixed floor(height/2),floor(width/2) cyclic shift train/eval; semantic fields or donor high bands only
architecture.mask: masked raw input; conservative cell and3x3 coefficient masks; shifted validity for shuffled fields; final pixel exact fallback
architecture.joint_trainable: RGB last4 encoder blocks+rgb projection+decoder; DSM last4 transformer blocks+decoder+classification head; earlier layers and all BN statistics frozen; dropout evaluation
architecture.new_head_initialization: seed42 after expert construction; projections and fusion built before interactions for common exact initialization
architecture.cross_input_group_layout: interleaved recipient/donor coefficient channels, each grouped convolution sees both
architecture.dropout: expert dropout eval throughout, early frozen and J0 last4 weights updated; all BN statistics frozen

evaluation.fixed8000: 10 primary conditions; selected evaluates all22 conditions
evaluation.precision: FP32 logits uniform stitch, TF32 enabled
evaluation.metric: NoBoundary mIoU_fg5 pooled; full and6class diagnostic
evaluation.joint_counts: 6^4 truth,rgb,dsm,candidate int64 per availability partition per scope/tile; references same masked input
evaluation.joint_counts_encoding: lossless sparse flat index/count int64 shape6^4, omitted bins exactly0; decode helper supplied; per condition/tile/scope/availability
